status.main_product: Commercial foodservice, beverage, and laundry equipment
status.scope_reason: The company manufactures and sells a line of commercial soft-serve ice cream machines under its own brand name (such as the Karma and Roma models).
status.evidence: According to the official Electrolux Professional product portal, the company manufactures and sells commercial countertop and floor-standing soft-serve ice cream dispensers, including the Karma and Roma models.

claims.claim: The company reports that its soft-serve dispensers achieve a "start to serve" freezing time from mix initialization to completed dispense in 10 minutes, as documented on the Electrolux Professional Soft Serve Product Line Page.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Soft Serve Product Line Page

claims.claim: The company reports that its soft-serve product family features a Defrost/Night Mode algorithm across its Karma series dispensers that stabilizes mix temperatures between 0°C and +2°C to keep the product fresh without freeze stress, as documented in the official Electrolux Professional Karma Pump Specification Manual.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Karma Product Datasheets / Manuals

claims.claim: Electrolux Professional offers the compact countertop K-Soft and Karma ranges, which serve up to 85 and 150 cones per hour respectively and are available in both gravity-fed and pump-fed variants.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Beverage Solutions Catalog / Product Pages

claims.claim: Electrolux Professional provides high-capacity configurations including the Capri countertop single-flavor model (up to 290 cones/hour) and the Firenze floor-standing single-flavor dispenser (up to 380 cones/hour).
claims.source: Electrolux Professional High Capacity Soft Serve Product Specifications

claims.claim: Electrolux Professional manufactures the multi-flavor Portofino countertop model (up to 600 cones/hour) and the Roma floor-standing model (up to 650 cones/hour), which feature dual 13-litre tanks and a cylinder system providing a two-flavor plus twist dispensing option.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional High Capacity Range Documentation

claims.claim: Electrolux Professional offers the GT Touch model, a specialized multi-product countertop dispenser capable of serving 5 distinct types of frozen treats, including soft-serve ice cream, frozen yogurt, chilled coffee cream, sorbet, and slush.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional GT Touch product literature and official video demonstrations

claims.claim: The company reports that its Roma floor-standing soft ice cream dispenser model delivers a maximum peak throughput capacity of up to 650 cones per hour.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Soft Serve Ice Cream Dispensers Product Specification Page

claims.claim: The company reports that its Portofino two-flavor countertop model achieves a maximum production throughput capacity of up to 600 cones per hour.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional High Capacity Soft Serve Portfolio Data Sheet

claims.claim: The company reports that its Capri high-volume countertop model line (including models CAP114DPA3PH and CAP118DPA3PH) delivers an hourly production throughput of up to 290 cones.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Capri Product Line Catalog and Technical Data Sheets (models CAP114DPA3PH and CAP118DPA3PH)

claims.claim: The company reports that its Firenze floor-standing soft-serve machine provides an hourly capacity of up to 380 cones, according to the Electrolux Professional equipment portfolio.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Firenze Technical Manual and Product Brochure

claims.claim: The company reports that its Karma pump-fed soft ice cream dispenser has an hourly capacity of up to 130 cones or 9 kg per hour, according to the Electrolux Professional technical specifications.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Soft Serve Product Pages & Technical Specifications

claims.claim: The company reports that its Karma Soft Ice Cream Dispenser features an integrated defrost/night mode that holds the product temperature at 0/+2°C to keep it fresh without continuous freezing system runtime, according to the Electrolux Professional Technical Specifications.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Technical Specifications (COD 563217)

claims.claim: The company reports that its Karma Soft Ice Cream Dispenser models, including the gravity model 563218 and pump model 563217, utilize eco-friendly R290 hydrocarbon refrigerant gas, as documented on the Electrolux Professional Soft Serve Product Pages.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Soft Serve Product Catalog (COD 563217, 563218)

claims.claim: The company reports that its GT Frozen granita, creams, and soft-ice cream dispenser with 2 bowls (model 562527) operates with a highly ecological R290 refrigerant charge weight of 118 grams, as detailed in the Electrolux Professional Datasheet.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional GT2PR290 Datasheet (Model 562527)

claims.claim: The company reports that its high-capacity countertop soft ice cream dispenser model (COD 560063) utilizes R452A refrigerant, as noted by equipment distributor Caterkwik.
claims.source: Caterkwik Electrolux Professional 560063 Product Listing

claims.claim: The company reports that its multi-product soft ice cream and frozen granita dispenser (GT2TR290) features a patented I-Tank Technology designed to prevent outer bowl ice accumulation, which simultaneously reduces condensation and improves energy efficiency, as stated in the Electrolux Professional Equipment Datasheet.
claims.source: https://electroluxprofessional.com

claims.claim: The company reports selling its professional equipment, including its cold food and soft-serve preparation lines, across five regional business areas (Food Europe, Food Americas, Food APAC & MEA, Beverage & Food Preparation, and Laundry) with commercial end-markets spanning over 110 countries.
claims.note: five regional business areas (Food Europe, Food Americas, Food APAC & MEA, Beverage & Food Preparation, and Laundry)
claims.source: https://www.electroluxprofessional.com/

claims.claim: The company reports that its worldwide after-sales service infrastructure is powered by a dedicated network of approximately 1,900 service technicians to maintain commercial equipment installations globally.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its worldwide after-sales service infrastructure is powered by a dedicated network of approximately 1,900 authorized service centres to maintain commercial equipment installations globally.
claims.source: https://www.electroluxprofessional.com/customer-care/

claims.claim: The company utilizes an authorized local partner network to distribute and service its professional beverage and soft-serve products across specific territories, such as utilizing Midwest Appliances to handle local adaptation, OEM warranties, and technical support in India.
claims.source: https://midwest.net.in/electrolux/

claims.claim: The company reports that its subsidiary SPM Drink Systems operates a primary manufacturing facility and headquarters in Spilamberto, Italy, which integrates automated processes and lean manufacturing principles, according to the SPM Drink Systems Production Sites Overview.
claims.source: https://spm-drink-systems.com

claims.claim: The company reports that the SPM Drink Systems factory in Spilamberto, Italy, possesses a production output capacity of 430 pieces per day across its frozen, soft-serve, hot line, and gear motor lines, according to the SPM Drink Systems Production Sites Overview.
claims.source: SPM Drink Systems Official Production Sites Overview (https://spm-drink-systems.com)

claims.claim: The company reports that the SPM production site in Rayong, Thailand, maintains an output capacity of 320 pieces per day on its cold bubbler line, according to the SPM Drink Systems Production Sites Overview.
claims.source: SPM Drink Systems Official Production Sites Overview (https://spm-drink-systems.com)

claims.claim: Electrolux Professional AB is a publicly traded corporation listed on the Nasdaq Stockholm exchange (Large Cap) under the ticker symbol EPRO-B, following its spin-off and share distribution from AB Electrolux on March 23, 2020.
claims.source: Electrolux Group Press Release & Nasdaq Stockholm Listing Details (https://electroluxgroup.com)

claims.claim: As an independent publicly traded group, the company's financial backing is sustained by commercial operations and market capitalization, recording total liabilities and shareholders' equity of SEK 13.0 billion as of December 31, 2025.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional AB Annual and Sustainability Report 2025 Balance Sheet Metrics via Fiscal.ai (https://fiscal.ai)

claims.claim: The company maintains access to institutional capital through major global asset management shareholders, with Nordea Investment Management AB holding 5.31% and Swedbank Robur Fonder AB holding 5.065% of the capital as of recent disclosures.
claims.corrected: The company maintains access to institutional capital through major global asset management shareholders, with Nordea Investment Management AB holding 5.301% and Swedbank Robur Fonder AB holding 5.065% of the capital as of recent disclosures.
claims.source: MarketScreener Electrolux Professional AB Ownership Profile (https://sa.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ELECTROLUX-PROFESSIONAL-A-105544687/company/)

claims.claim: To secure debt-based financial backing, the company established a Medium Term Note (MTN) program and executed debt financing, issuing Loan 4 under its 2026 MTN Base Prospectus on August 26, 2026.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Group Debt Financing & Risk Management Page (https://www.electroluxprofessionalgroup.com/en/investors/debt-financing/)

claims.claim: The company reported dedicated access to R&D capital, investing a total of SEK 556 million in 2025 (averaging roughly 4% of net sales annually) across its global competence centers and innovation hubs to back cross-segment product lines including food and beverage equipment.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Group Annual and Sustainability Report 2025 (https://www.electroluxprofessionalgroup.com/sv/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2021/10/Electrolux-Professional-Group-Ars-och-hallbarhetsredovisning-2025.pdf)

claims.claim: The company reports that its food and beverage segment, which includes soft-serve and frozen drink products, generated net sales of SEK 5,895m in 2019, accounting for approximately 64% of Electrolux Professional's total net sales.
claims.source: Electrolux Professional Group Information Brochure

claims.claim: The company reports that Electrolux Professional overall generated total revenue of SEK 9,281 million in 2019, reflecting an organic sales decline of 0.3% year-over-year.
